package.description: A lightweight Markdown editor with syntax highlighting and a reader mode.

en-US.description: A lightweight Markdown editor with syntax highlighting and a reader mode.
en-US.longDescription: MarkPad++ is a lightweight desktop Markdown editor for Windows. It pairs a syntax-highlighting source view with a live reader mode, and adds tabbed editing, find-in-document, theming with light and dark modes, and export to DOCX and ODT.
en-US.name: MarkPad++
